snippet.title: PlayStation - Simple 1500 Series Vol 092 - The Tozan RPG - Ginrei no Hasha (2002)
snippet.description:
DESCRIPTION
The Tozan RPG is a Role-Playing game, developed by HuneX and published by D3Publisher, which was released in Japan in 2002.
